title: A bolder hand for the landing page
question: Three bolder structures for the same organizer, world and proof. The rail from the first hand is set aside; none of these is a repeat.

options.label: The Door
options.lineage: the staff phone at the entrance
options.thesis: The first thing you see is a verdict, full width: the moment a ticket either works or doesn't.
options.viewport: A giant Admitted verdict with the guest's handle, the two other verdicts beneath, and the organizer pitch and action below.
options.risk: Strong and unusual, but it leads with the door and not the money, so the royalty line has to land fast.

options.label: The Statement
options.thesis: The page opens as the organizer's own books: every line of an event's money, itemised, with the royalty line lit.
options.viewport: A large headline and the action above a wide settlement table whose resale royalty row is the one highlighted.
options.risk: Reads as an admin screen unless the headline does the persuading; its figures are synthetic and labelled so.

options.label: The Scrubber
options.thesis: The sale ends, the page keeps going: drag from sale day to show night and watch resale, royalties and bids accumulate.
options.viewport: An oversized headline, the action, then a draggable three-point time track with three readouts beneath.
options.risk: Interactive and memorable, but every figure is synthetic, so it must be labelled and never read as a result.
